meta.title: CV Rush — the hiring process, as a game
meta.description: An open-source 2D browser game about getting your CV through a hiring process. Built in the open.

landing.title: CV Rush
landing.tagline: Grab your CV and race through recruiters, an ATS machine and interviews to deliver it at the company.
landing.statusBody: We are building the foundations. There is no playable game yet: follow the roadmap or help us build it.
